mnemonic.meaning: 弱 is weak: it gets weaker by itself. To weaken, to abate.
mnemonic.reading: YO, WAH, MARU (よわまる): the storm weakens into a small circle (まる).

examples.ja: 台風の勢いが弱まった。
examples.en: The typhoon has weakened.

items.note: Intransitive. 弱める = you weaken it. 強まる (Level 16) is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 泊 is stay overnight: you let someone stay. To put them up.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, MEh RUE (とめる): you put up your friend, but his toes stink. You rue it.

examples.ja: 友達を一晩泊めた。
examples.en: I put my friend up for the night.

items.note: Transitive. 泊まる = to stay overnight.

mnemonic.meaning: The same (同) one (一). Identical.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, EAT SUE (どういつ): Sue eats identical dough every day.

examples.ja: 二つの事件は同一人物によるものだ。
examples.en: The two incidents were committed by the same person.

items.note: Formal; 同じ is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 強 is strong: it gets stronger by itself. To intensify.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, YO, MARU (つよまる): the wind gets stronger and spins in a circle (まる).

examples.ja: 夜になって風が強まった。
examples.en: The wind got stronger at night.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 強める (Level 8).

mnemonic.meaning: 次 is next: to rank next to, to follow.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, GOO (つぐ): the goo ranks next to slime.

examples.ja: 彼の実力は社長に次ぐと言われている。
examples.en: His ability is said to be second only to the president's.

items.note: 〜に次ぐ = second only to. 相次ぐ = to happen one after another.

mnemonic.meaning: Stamp (印) and print (刷). Printing.
mnemonic.reading: IN, SAT, SUE (いんさつ): Sue sat in the print shop all day, printing.

examples.ja: 資料を十部印刷した。
examples.en: I printed ten copies of the handout.

items.note: プリントする is also common. 印刷機 = printing press.

mnemonic.meaning: Start (発) something bright (明). An invention.
mnemonic.reading: HATS, MAY (はつめい): May invents a hat that lights up.

examples.ja: 電話はベルが発明した。
examples.en: The telephone was invented by Bell.

items.note: Inventing something new. Discovering what exists is 発見 (はっけん).

mnemonic.meaning: Meet (会) and fit (合) together. A meeting, an assembly.
mnemonic.reading: KITE, GO (かいごう): the kite club meets. Go!

examples.ja: 地域の会合に参加した。
examples.en: I took part in a local meeting.

items.note: Formal gathering of a group. 会議 is a meeting to discuss and decide.

mnemonic.meaning: The interval (間) between, the gap (隔). Spacing.
mnemonic.reading: CAN, CACK (かんかく): leave a gap between cans, or they cack. Same sound as 感覚 (sense).

examples.ja: バスは十分間隔で来る。
examples.en: Buses come every ten minutes.

items.note: Time or space between: 間隔を空ける (leave space).

mnemonic.meaning: The middle (中) of the day (日). Daytime.
mnemonic.reading: KNIT, CHEW (にっちゅう): during the day you knit and chew gum.

examples.ja: 日中はとても暑かった。
examples.en: It was very hot during the day.

items.note: Context matters: 日中関係 = Japan-China relations.

mnemonic.meaning: Resign (辞) and withdraw (退). Declining an offer.
mnemonic.reading: GEE, TIE (じたい): "Gee, no tie for me." You decline.

examples.ja: 彼は賞の受け取りを辞退した。
examples.en: He declined to accept the award.

items.note: Polite, formal refusal of an offer or a post. 断る is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Start (発) it going (行) out into the world. Issue, publication.
mnemonic.reading: HACK, COKE (はっこう): the hacker publishes his Coke recipe.

examples.ja: 新しいカードが発行された。
examples.en: A new card was issued.

items.note: Issuing passports, tickets, magazines, currency.

mnemonic.meaning: Main (主) and essential (要). Principal, major.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE, YO (しゅよう): "Shoes, yo, are the main thing."

examples.ja: 主要な都市を回った。
examples.en: We toured the major cities.

items.note: Formal. 主な is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: The person (者) before (前). The former (vs 後者, the latter).
mnemonic.reading: ZEN, SHA (ぜんしゃ): pick the former: the Zen Shah.

examples.ja: AプランとBプランがあるが、前者のほうが安い。
examples.en: There's Plan A and Plan B; the former is cheaper.

items.note: Pair with 後者 (Level 13).

mnemonic.meaning: 順 is order: in order, your turn.
mnemonic.reading: JUNE (じゅん) comes after May, in order.

examples.ja: 名前の順に並んでください。
examples.en: Please line up in order of name.

items.note: 順番 is everyday. 順に = in order. Also in 順調 (Level 1).

mnemonic.meaning: Decrease (減) to a little (少). Decline, reduction.
mnemonic.reading: GEN, SHOW (げんしょう): Gen's show audience keeps decreasing. Same sound as 現象 (phenomenon).

examples.ja: 日本の人口は減少している。
examples.en: Japan's population is decreasing.

items.note: Formal. 減る is everyday. 増加 (ぞうか) = increase.

mnemonic.meaning: Gold (金) and coins (銭). Money, cash.
mnemonic.reading: KIN, SEN (きんせん): your kin give you sen coins. Money.

examples.ja: 金銭のトラブルを避けたい。
examples.en: I want to avoid money trouble.

items.note: Formal. お金 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 撒 has 扌 (hand): your hand scatters seeds. To sprinkle.
mnemonic.reading: MACK (まく): Mack sprinkles salt on the fries.

examples.ja: 庭に水を撒いた。
examples.en: I sprinkled water in the garden.

items.note: Usually in kana: まく. 種をまく = sow seeds (蒔く).

mnemonic.meaning: 沖 is 氵 (water) + 中 (middle): the middle of the water. The open sea.
mnemonic.reading: OKEY (おき): "Okey," the sailor says, heading offshore.

examples.ja: 船は沖に出た。
examples.en: The boat went out to sea.

items.note: The sea away from the shore. 沖合 = offshore.

mnemonic.meaning: 遅 is late: a delay.
mnemonic.reading: OH, COO, RAY (おくれ): "Oh, the train's late again." A delay.

examples.ja: 電車に十分の遅れが出ている。
examples.en: The train is running ten minutes late.

items.note: 遅れを取る = to fall behind.

mnemonic.meaning: Everything mixed (混) and rough (雑). Congestion, crowding.
mnemonic.reading: CONS, ZATS (こんざつ): the con is so crowded there's no zats space to walk.

examples.ja: 朝の駅はとても混雑している。
examples.en: Stations are very crowded in the morning.

items.note: Formal; 混む is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: A farming (農) house (家). A farmer.
mnemonic.reading: NO, CAR (のうか): the farmer has no car, only a tractor.

examples.ja: 祖父母は農家だ。
examples.en: My grandparents are farmers.

items.note: Also the farmhouse itself. 農業 = agriculture.

mnemonic.meaning: TABBY, TABBY (たびたび): the tabby cat comes back again and again, often.

examples.ja: たびたびご迷惑をおかけしてすみません。
examples.en: I'm sorry to trouble you again and again.

items.note: Kanji: 度々. A bit formal; よく / 何度も are everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 馴 has 馬 (horse): the horse gets used to you and becomes tame.
mnemonic.reading: NAH, RAY RUE (なれる): "Nah, Ray, you'll get used to it."

examples.ja: この猫は人に馴れている。
examples.en: This cat is used to people.

items.note: 馴れる is for animals and becoming familiar. 慣れる is the usual kanji for habits.

mnemonic.meaning: 便 is convenience: a flight, a mail service.
mnemonic.reading: BIN (びん): your mail is in the bin on the next flight.

examples.ja: 次の便で大阪に行きます。
examples.en: I'll go to Osaka on the next flight.

items.note: びん = flight, post: 航空便 (airmail). べん = convenience: 便利.

mnemonic.meaning: Exactly (正) noon (午). Midday.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW, GO (しょうご): the show must go on at noon sharp.

examples.ja: 会議は正午に始まる。
examples.en: The meeting starts at noon.

items.note: Exactly 12:00. 午前 / 午後 = a.m. / p.m.

mnemonic.meaning: Use (用) it where suitable (適). Applying a rule.
mnemonic.reading: TECHY, YO (てきよう): "Techy, yo, apply the rule!"

examples.ja: この割引は学生にも適用される。
examples.en: This discount also applies to students.

items.note: Applying rules, laws, insurance. Not applying for a job (応募).

mnemonic.meaning: 県 is a prefecture, like Japan's states.
mnemonic.reading: KEN (けん) lives in Chiba prefecture.

examples.ja: 私は静岡県の出身です。
examples.en: I'm from Shizuoka Prefecture.

items.note: Japan has 43 県 plus 都 (Tokyo), 道 (Hokkaido) and 府 (Osaka, Kyoto).

mnemonic.meaning: Make it real (実) and carry it out (施). Implementation.
mnemonic.reading: GEE, SHE (じっし): "Gee, she actually carried out the plan!"

examples.ja: 来月から新しい制度を実施する。
examples.en: We'll put the new system into effect from next month.

items.note: Formal; events, tests, policies. 実行 (Level 6) is carrying out a plan.

mnemonic.meaning: A long (長) period (期). Long-term.
mnemonic.reading: CHO, KEY (ちょうき): a long-term key to the house.

examples.ja: 長期の休みを取った。
examples.en: I took a long break.

items.note: 短期 (たんき) = short-term. 長期的 = long-term.
